items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And old man Lewis the man had quite a few false teeth.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he plays good. He'd take them out and play. He'd take them out and play without a team. He'd have none precious system about this world. He'd take them out. He'd have false teeth. And old man Lewis the man had quite a few false teeth. You know Gilbert Youngkin though?

When you had, before you got them false teeth, Gilbert Youngkin playing the side, either side or the middle. He had all these games. He'd get tired. He'd play. You ever get tired there, he'd play. I'm with you all over his mouth. Yeah, I was seeing him get his lip all bust up and he said, well, who's stopping him from playing?
